installCommand: if [ -d 'front-end' ]; then (cd front-end && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund)); elif [ -d 'frontend' ]; then (cd frontend && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund)); else (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || npm install --no-audit --no-fund); fi
buildCommand: if [ -d 'front-end' ]; then (cd front-end && npm run build) && rm -rf dist && cp -r front-end/dist dist; elif [ -d 'frontend' ]; then (cd frontend && npm run build) && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist dist; else npm run build && mkdir -p front-end && cp -r dist front-end/dist 2>/dev/null || true; fi
